verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm automatic daily backups, but only on Pro, Team and Enterprise plans. Nothing in the evidence shows the schedule can be viewed or configured, or that restores are self-serve. A community report says the pg_dump-based nightly backups took one customer's database offline every night, which the CEO confirmed and answered by suggesting PITR (point-in-time recovery). That is an operational caveat, not evidence that backups don't run. Missing for 10: visible or configurable backup schedule, documented self-serve restore flow, PITR documentation, backups on the free plan, independent confirmation that backups run without disruption.
